verdict.rationale: Shopify's POS features page documents Sidekick, Shopify's built-in AI assistant. Users can ask it for reordering suggestions based on sales velocity and seasonality. They can also have it recommend stock transfers between locations and create them automatically, which is real task delegation. missing for 10: evidence of delegation beyond inventory tasks (e.g., checkout, staff or customer workflows), clarity on whether Sidekick runs inside the POS app itself or only in the admin, in-depth docs on Sidekick capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration.
